dedupe_keys.name: brainport highway pilot road side camera detection

description: The AUTOPILOT project partners publish roadside-camera and connected-vehicle observations from the Automotive Campus test track in the Netherlands. Zenodo supplies draft and final archive packages free under CC BY 4.0. The description covers a ten-minute obstacle scenario with camera detections, absolute and relative object positions, GPS, vehicle controls and hazard messages. These observations can benchmark perception and communication components in automated-driving simulations. Related G6 data-autopilot-livorno-connected-roadworks-logs records a separate Italian demonstration. Coverage is the Brainport test-track experiment, not general road operation. The four listed archives include draft and final variants and should not be counted as four independent trials. Sensor synchronisation, detection error and internal encodings require checking before reuse. No archive was downloaded or safety-performance claim tested. Additional AUTOPILOT highway sessions compare camera-only, IMU-only and combined detection, a detection-disabled reference, manual driving with instructions, simulated autonomous ACC operation and responses at detected hazards. Source descriptions specify 25-lap VW Tiguan trials, a 12-lap manual Jaguar F-Pace trial, 18-lap ACC operation and 25-lap hazard-response operation. A control-centre session publishes instructions for four identified hazards; the original roadside-camera session observes ten minutes of the track. Common stream descriptions include anomaly, hazard, ADAS-command, position and vehicle-state messages, and anomaly-image pointers. Files include draft/final labels whose samples may overlap; nine deposits are not nine proven independent experiments. No archive or media was opened, and actual detection/response performance remains unverified.
